items.Sentence: The treatment system consists of influent screening and grit removal;
biological removal of biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) and nitrogen in aerobic, anoxic, and pre-anoxic basins;

waste activated sludge pumping removes excessive biomass from the system, followed by a proprietary sludge digestion process, dewatering via centrifuge, and disposal to a Class III solid waste landfill.

The Facility includes a 5 million gallon aerated influent equalization basin and a 3.35 million gallon equalization basin, which provides equalization storage capacity for extended wet weather flows and plant return flows.
